output.summary: Keep Pi worker process output inside project runtime tmp.

approvedRows.question: Should Pi process-session worker output default to project-local runtime tmp instead of OS tmp?
approvedRows.currentState: The default Pi process session output path used the OS temp directory, which can be outside a Pi sandbox scoped to the CodeWiki project.
approvedRows.desiredState: Default Pi worker process output is captured under .codewiki/runtime/tmp/<trace-id>/runtime/pi-workers/ unless a host explicitly overrides it.
approvedRows.rationale: Project-scoped Pi sandboxes can block or intercept external filesystem access, so runtime scratch must stay inside the project boundary by default.
approvedRows.userImpact: Users get more reliable worker dispatch in sandboxed Pi hosts because default output files stay within the CodeWiki checkout.
approvedRows.maintainerImpact: Maintainers get a regression test for project-local Pi process-session output paths.
approvedRows.recommendationRationale: Evidence supports this intention as valuable and safe to plan.
